intent: Context telemetry-ingestion-processing runtime configuration (merge the keys of the queued flyway-config profile). Base document: spring.application.name=telemetry-ingestion-processing; spring.flyway.locations=classpath:db/migration; spring.r2dbc.url/username/password from env with PostgreSQL r2dbc defaults; telemetry.backfill.window-seconds=60; telemetry.buffer.capacity=1024; management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,metrics; logging.file.name=logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log; logging.structured.format.file=ecs; logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-file-size=10MB; logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-history=7. Second document with spring.config.activate.on-profile=test: spring.r2dbc.url=r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetrydb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE and spring.flyway.enabled=false. No runtime dependency on any log shipper.
